AdverseEventSection.description: One source-owned section; no all or reporter section.

ReportId.description: Opaque published digits with source carried separately, never a prefixed wrapper.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Exact native report identity and an optional independently paged section.

drug_index.description: Absolute source-array index; required only for identifier sections.

id.description: Published report ID with no source prefix.

section.description: FAERS owns drugs, reactions and identifiers; MAUDE owns devices and narrative. Omitted means card only.

section_limit.description: Whole source rows per section page.

section_offset.description: Offset within the selected native section.

snapshot.description: Checked retained report snapshot for provider-free continuation.

source.description: FAERS by default; MAUDE is explicit.
